titleTr: Keşke farklı yapsaydım: should have / might have

explainTr: 'Should have + V3' geçmişte yapılması gereken ama yapılmayan şeyi anlatır; pişmanlık ya da eleştiri taşır: I should have called you. (Seni aramalıydım.) Olumsuzu: I shouldn't have said that. (Bunu söylememeliydim.)
'Might have + V3' geçmişle ilgili bir olasılıktır: She might have forgotten. (Unutmuş olabilir.) Emin değilsin, tahmin ediyorsun.
Dikkat: 'should' tek başına şimdi ya da gelecek için tavsiyedir: You should rest. 'Should have' ise bitmiş bir olaya bakar. Fiilin 3. halini (V3) kullanmayı unutma: done, made, gone, forgotten.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'aramalıydım' tek kelimeyle pişmanlık verir; 'unutmuş olabilir' ise tahmin demektir. İngilizcede bunun için iki parça gerekir: should have + V3 (pişmanlık) ve might have + V3 (olasılık). 'Have' hep yalın kalır, fiil 3. hale geçer.

examples.en: I should have read the whole plan.
You shouldn't have worried so much.
He might have forgotten his keys.
They might not have heard the bell.

exercises.q: I failed the quiz. I ___ studied more.
She ___ left the children alone. It was dangerous.
exercises.whyTr: Geçmişte yapılmaması gereken şey: shouldn't have + V3.

exercises.q: I don't know where Emre is. He ___ gone to the library.
exercises.whyTr: Geçmişle ilgili bir olasılık: might have + V3.

exercises.q: You look sick. You ___ see a doctor.
exercises.whyTr: Şimdi için tavsiye: should + yalın fiil.

exercises.q: Hafsa didn't read the sub plan. She ___ read it.
exercises.whyTr: Yapmadı ve pişman: should have read.
'Should have' den sonra V3 gelir: left.

exercises.answer: I should have asked for help
exercises.whyTr: Sıra: özne + should have + V3 + gerisi.

exercises.answer: She might have forgotten her keys

exercises.q: The door is open. Someone ___ forgotten to close it.
exercises.whyTr: Geçmişle ilgili tahmin: might have + V3.
Pişmanlık geçmişe bakar: should have + V3.

exercises.q: You should ___ told me about the test.

reading.title: A mistake and a lesson
reading.text:
Last Thursday, Hafsa made a mistake. Ms. Carter left a sub plan for her math class, but Hafsa only read the first page. She did not notice the second page, which said, "Give the spelling test at 10:00." The students were confused, and Hafsa realized her error only after lunch. She felt embarrassed.

That night, she told Emre what happened. "I should have read the whole plan," she said. "I should have arrived earlier, too, to check everything." Emre listened carefully. "Maybe some students knew about the test," he said. "You should have asked them. But you shouldn't blame yourself so much, Mom."

The next morning, Hafsa apologized to Ms. Carter. Ms. Carter smiled and forgave her. "My first day as a teacher was worse," she said. "I might have lost the classroom keys that day! Everyone makes mistakes. The important thing is to learn from them." She also gave Hafsa some advice: "Prepare the night before, and always read the whole plan."

Hafsa felt disappointed in herself, but she also felt better. At home, she wrote a short checklist and put it on her kitchen wall. It said, "Read every page. Ask the students. Arrive early." She decided that a mistake is not the end of the story. It is the beginning of a better plan.

options: The spelling test on page two
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'She did not notice the second page ... spelling test'.

questions.q: What did Hafsa say to Emre?
options: She should have read the whole plan.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'I should have read the whole plan.'

options: She forgave Hafsa and gave advice.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'Ms. Carter smiled and forgave her.'

questions.q: What did Hafsa put on her kitchen wall?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'wrote a short checklist and put it on her kitchen wall'.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: You look upset, Hafsa. What happened?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I made a mistake at school. I forgot to give the spelling test.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Oh, that isn't terrible. Did anybody get angry?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: No. But I should have read the whole sub plan. I only read the first page.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Everyone makes mistakes. You should have asked the students, too. They might have known about the test.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: You're right. Children often know the routine.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Did you apologize to the teacher?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, this morning. She was very kind.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Then you shouldn't worry so much. Next time you'll be better prepared.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I wrote a checklist, and I will read every page.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: That's a great idea. I should have made one when I started my job!

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you, Linda. You always make me feel better.

questions.q: What did Hafsa forget to do?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'I forgot to give the spelling test.'

questions.q: What did Hafsa read of the sub plan?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'I only read the first page.'

questions.q: What might the students have known?
questions.whyTr: Linda: 'They might have known about the test.'

writing.promptTr: Yaptığın bir hatayı ve neyi farklı yapman gerektiğini yaz. should have, shouldn't have ve might have kullan (80-100 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write about a mistake you made and what you should have done. Use should have, shouldn't have and might have (80-100 words).
writing.model: Last week I made a mistake at the bank. I forgot my ID, so I could not open the account. I should have checked my bag before I left home. I shouldn't have been in such a hurry. The clerk was kind and said that other customers might have done the same thing. Today I went back with my ID, and everything was fine. I also learned something useful. Next time, I will prepare a small list the night before. A list is simple, but it can save a lot of time.
checklistTr: En az bir 'should have + V3' cümlen var mı?
'shouldn't have' ile yapılmaması gereken bir şey yazdın mı?
'might have' ile bir olasılık anlattın mı?
'Have' den sonra fiilin 3. hali (done, made, forgotten) geldi mi?

examSet.q: I was late. I ___ left home earlier.
They ___ shouted at the children. It was not kind.
examSet.whyTr: Yapılmaması gereken geçmiş eylem: shouldn't have.

examSet.q: Linda isn't answering. She ___ gone to bed early.
examSet.whyTr: Geçmişle ilgili tahmin: might have + V3.

examSet.q: You should have ___ the whole page.
I want to ___ for being late to class.
She felt ___ when she made the mistake in front of everyone.
Which word is closest in meaning to "advice"?

Tom didn't check his alarm and overslept. He missed the first class. He said, "I should have set two alarms."

What does Tom regret?
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'I should have set two alarms.'

examSet.q:
Maria forgot her keys. She called her neighbor, who might have an extra set. Luckily, the neighbor was home.

Why did Maria call her neighbor?
options: The neighbor might have an extra key.
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'who might have an extra set'.
